messages:
riley (partnerships): Heads-up: AuroraCompute reached out to co-host a technical webinar + live hardware demo on May 12 @ 9:30am PT. They want a 20m tech talk, 20m live demo (hardware + cloud tie-in), 15m customer Q&A. Can we plan here?

tori (events): Dates look clear. Virtual webinar + optional backstage stream for VIPs? Do we need a separate webinar room for the hardware capture?

riley (partnerships): Good call. Partner wants a camera feed of the rack/demo + HDMI capture. We can do main Zoom for slides + embedded RTMP for the hardware feed. Need AV checklist.

sam (marketing): Swag requests: 150 branded threaded beanies, 200 stickers, 40 hardware "hands-on" kits (USB power + microcontroller). Aurora can cover EU customs but asks Redwood to handle label printing. Budget wise ok if split 50/50.

adele (solutions): For the demo we'll need: an Aurora edge device on our staging VLAN, service account with scoped API keys, and sample workload (no customer data). Also want a dry-run script and a recorded backup demo in case of hardware flake.

amit (eng-runtime): I can build a short demo harness. Proposal: dockerized demo that runs a local sim if it can't reach the device. Health check will ping local agent then remote. If remote unreachable > 5 retries, switch to local sim and notify host.

luis (AuroraCompute): Confirm Aurora will ship two demo racks to Redwood office (SJC) and an additional live-stream kit to our HQ for remote shots. I'll share ship ETA and ops contact (nora@auroracloud.com). We'll provide SSH accounts to the demo device for the rehearsal.

riley (partnerships): Draft run order suggestion:

    09:30  doors + intro (5m)  Riley + Luis
    09:35  Redwood infra + model-serving overview (10m)  Amit
    09:45  Aurora hardware overview + edge use-cases (10m)  Luis
    09:55  Live demo: end-to-end (20m)  Adele + Aurora eng
    10:15  Customer panel highlights (5m)  Sam
    10:20  Q&A + wrap (15m)

riley (partnerships): Action list (owners + due dates):
 - Luis (Aurora): shipping manifest + ops contact by Apr 28
 - Amit: demo harness + recorded fallback by May 1
 - Sam: swag SKU list + co-brand mockups by Apr 26
 - Tori: rehearsal calendar + AV checklist by May 4
 - Adele: sanitized workload + runbook by May 6

sam (marketing): Need Aurora vector logo (SVG) and brand lock. Also want a co-branded landing page + separate RSVP funnel for partners. Legal blurbs to marketing by Apr 29.

luis (AuroraCompute): Uploading logos now to shared drive: https://drive.aurora.example/co-brand.zip. Agree to provide co-marketing copy.

amit (eng-runtime): Health-check snippet we'll run pre-demo:

    #!/bin/sh
    STATUS=$(curl -s -m 3 https://demo-device.internal/health || echo "down")
    if [ "$STATUS" = "ok" ]; then echo "device-ok"; else echo "device-down"; fi

amit (eng-runtime): If device-down then trigger local-sim: docker run --rm redwood/demo-sim:latest. I'll add a Slack-only alert channel for rehearsals.

adele (solutions): Confirming we'll use a customer-like workload (small prompts, < 512 tokens). I'll scrub any live PII and provide transcript redaction rules.

tori (events): Proposed rehearsals: May 6 9am PT (AV tech run), May 9 10am PT (dress). Each 45m. I'll provision the RTMP stream and test keys.

sam (marketing): Swag logistics: shipping manifest template needed. Also, want to do a sign-up for beanie sizes on landing page (collect size only). I'll post the manifest doc here once ready.

luis (AuroraCompute): Nora (ops) will coordinate labels. For customs, Aurora covers duties outside US. We'll need Redwood to provide recipient list for non-US shipments by May 2.

riley (partnerships): Quick legal note: avoid making performance claims vs competitor names. We'll run the script by legal early next week.

deploy-bot: calendar created: "Redwood + Aurora: Edge & Inference Deep Dive" May 12 09:30-10:30 PT  invites pending.

amit (eng-runtime): I'll drop the rehearsal checklist tomorrow. It will include: network test, video capture test, device power-on check, health-check run, fallback script, and host roles.

riley (partnerships): Great. If there are no blockers, let's aim to lock speakers and swag by Apr 26 and finalize the landing page by Apr 29. Thanks all. :rocket:
